Coniinum Bromatum.

Crystallised Bromohydrate of Conicine. C6 H17 NHBr.

Clinical.─Head, empty sensation in. Inactivity. Mental apathy.

Characteristics.─Conii. bro. has produced symptoms of mind and head. Coffee dissipated them.

SYMPTOMS.

1. Mind.─Difficulty in intellectual work.─State of inactivity, rather than a tendency to sleep.

2. Head.─Cerebral emptiness and vertigo.
